# Patients

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

The register of everyone, found by record number, place, stage or owner.

## What is on the screen

1. Find a person. Search by name, record number or place.
2. Everyone now. Open movements and stays. Open a row for the person's details.
3. Add patient. Register a new synthetic person when they are not found.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
